target_customer: Knowledge workers who repeat browser tasks and do not code
problem: Repetitive clicking and typing across websites cannot be automated without code or an API.
business_model: Chrome extension with paid plans (pricing not verified)

founders.name: Brian Noguchi
previous_startups: Lever (cofounder, YC S12; outcome not stated on the page)
founders.background_notes: YC page only; no education or other employers listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recording and replaying DOM interactions robustly across arbitrary sites is brittle and needs a lot of edge case handling, but is within reach of a small team.

defensibility.rationale: A Chrome extension recorder is easy to copy and similar tools launched around the same time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents acting against it; later rivals such as Bardeen and Axiom appeared in results.

market_need_then: The pitch compares it to Excel macros for any website; no dated demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses trysmartcuts.com, a prefix domain; the plain name was not the company's domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain: Automate repetitive work on any website in minutes. Without code.

brand_strength.rationale: Search results show many similarly named Chrome extensions and no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Smartcuts is a tiny team (three listed on the YC page) with a single founder who previously cofounded Lever. No outside round, acquisition, shutdown or layoff was found and the site was reported updated in 2026, so it looks like a small going concern. With no verified funding or traction, the story is stalled or quiet rather than clearly failed or successful.
notes: Funding: aggregators (Extruct, CB Insights, Simplify) say about 125K to 130K total, mostly the YC deal, with HOF Capital and SignalFire listed as investors; seen only on aggregators so unverified and not recorded as a round. CB Insights shows a 3.06M option or warrant value that is likely an error. Competitors: Bardeen exited stealth in Feb 2022 with a 3.5M seed and Hexomatic's extension launched Jan 2022, both about a year after the W21 batch, so none are listed as of founding. Axiom.ai also exists but no dated source was found.
